answer: Comet-window trellis quorum bond: each identity takes one trellis cell, locks 70, and per epoch in the comet window gathers 3 co-signatures from distinct neighbors, cipher-sealed. Auditors verify the 3 cipher seals; signing over 2 burns both. First 24, thousandth 24: 1,000 fakes pay 24,000 plus 70,000 locked, needing 1,500 neighbors, at most 2 trellis cells each. A rented-quorum ring fails on the cap. An honest agent pays 24, keeps the bond.
